name: Average rule
summary: Two H-boxes with labels a and b, connected through a NOT, add their labels.
description:
Two arity-2 H-boxes with labels $a$ and $b$ that are connected to each other via a NOT gate and whose other legs meet in a Z-spider produce the state $2\,(|0\rangle + \frac{a+b}{2}|1\rangle)$, i.e. twice an H-box with the *average* $\frac{a+b}{2}$ as its label. Summing over the internal wire, exactly one of the two H-boxes is 'active'.

Together with the [multiply rule](../zh-multiply/) this lets one do arithmetic with H-box labels. The 2021 completeness paper uses a [variant without the division by 2](../zh-average-prime/), which also works over rings without a half.
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
